BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE course_plan_request ADD COLUMN initial_allocation_json jsonb NULL, ADD COLUMN initial_allocation_hash varchar(64) NULL;
ALTER TABLE course_plan_request ADD CONSTRAINT ck_initial_allocation_pair CHECK (((initial_allocation_json IS NULL AND initial_allocation_hash IS NULL) OR (initial_allocation_json IS NOT NULL AND initial_allocation_hash IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(initial_allocation_json)='object' AND initial_allocation_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND diagnostic_plan_id IS NOT NULL AND intent_json->>'source'='TEACHER' AND intent_json->>'reason'='INITIAL')) IS TRUE);
CREATE FUNCTION protect_initial_allocation_checkpoint() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN
 IF OLD.initial_allocation_json IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.initial_allocation_json IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.initial_allocation_json OR NEW.initial_allocation_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.initial_allocation_hash) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'initial allocation checkpoint is immutable'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_initial_allocation_checkpoint BEFORE UPDATE ON course_plan_request FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_initial_allocation_checkpoint();
COMMIT;
